meaning: Frozen changed/untracked task source inventory; not archive equivalence, deployed acceptance, signing or production approval.

inventory_policy.selection: Git changes since receiving base plus untracked files, complete task import subtrees and four immutable provenance manifests.
mutable_narrative_exclusions: docs/** except drive-handover subtree and the four listed immutable manifests
inventory_policy.hash_algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps([{path,bytes,sha256},...], sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True), files sorted by path.
inventory_policy.unchanged_repository_dependencies: Not a whole-repository snapshot. The native build evidence independently fingerprints native/burimunsi plus upstream/collect.

archive_identity_basis.method: Reuse root-owned full-byte ZIP verification; this reconciliation hashes selected extracted source files, not ZIP archives again.

files.role: current nine-archive verification metadata; archive identities remain separate from candidate source
